dedupe_keys.name: nz electricity distribution areas network boundaries prototype

description: The NZ emergency-geospatial publisher provides a prototype of electricity distribution network boundaries, sourced from the Electricity Networks Aotearoa lines-company map. The source says it was published for Waikato CDEM emergency use. Polygon attributes identify the network name and related contact descriptors. The publisher warns that the layer may be incomplete or removed without warning and directs users to the source or local company before decisions. No operational network capacity or asset topology is established. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The metadata gives a source referral and completeness warning, without a clear reuse grant. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include Transpower transmission assets in the Eagle critical-infrastructure catalogue.
